title: 3 Years Ago, Attack on Titan Finale Proved Why It Remains a Modern Classic
content:
When it comes to modern anime, specifically those released in the 2010s and 2020s, Attack on Titan’s legacy can’t be matched with anything else. Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the manga reached its controversial finale in 2021, which sparked so much fury from fans that the creator was losing sleep over it. However, the controversy didn’t last for long when MAPPA took over the anime series for the final season. Although WIT Studio worked on the first three seasons of the anime, it faced difficulty meeting the tight deadlines since the manga was already over. It didn’t take long for MAPPA to take over the helm, and that probably saved the franchise’s legacy.

Established in 2011, MAPPA is known as one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan. While its popularity skyrocketed in the 2020s with the release of Jujutsu Kaisen and a few other acclaimed shows, the studio had a strong foundation with exceptional shows and movies under its belt ever since its establishment. Fans naturally had high expectations from the studio for the final season, especially since the time-skip changed the entire narrative. MAPPA not only lived up to the expectations, but delivered the best possible version of the story in the final season and special episodes. The anime reached its conclusion on November 4th, 2023, with the release of the second special episode of Attack on Titan: Final Season – The Final Chapters.

MAPPA Saved Attack on Titan ‘s Legacy With Exceptional Adaptation

While WIT Studio laid down the foundation of the story with the first three seasons, MAPPA wrapped up the anime with the best possible version. Considering how much fans hated the finale when the manga was being serialized, not many expected that the controversy would completely die down after the anime adaptation. Isayama contributed to

Unlike what one might expect, the change in studio wasn’t a major issue and did nothing to change fans’ enjoyment of the series. WIT Studio laid the foundation of the incredible story within the first three seasons. The fluid movements through the ODM gears and the cinematic sequences are still praised among fans. The color composition fit the mood of the story incredibly as it follows Eren’s journey. However, when it comes to MAPPA’s adaptation, it leans more towards darker shading and gritty details that are closer to the manga.

Many fans preferred the original art style more while also complimenting MAPPA’s adaptation, especially considering the short deadline. Season 3 was a roller coaster of emotions, and while WIT Studio couldn’t have adapted the entire story, it plays a huge role in the franchise’s current legacy. Following the time-skip, the story changed completely as Eren saw the truth of the world through the powers of the Founding Titan. He set his plan in motion and did everything he could to save Eldia, even if it came at the cost of stomping on 80% of the world’s population.

Do you think MAPPA delivered the perfect ending for Attack on Titan ? What moment from the finale made the biggest impression on you? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: Netflix’s Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Officially a Hit With Millions of Views
content:
A new report confirms that Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is one of the biggest hits of the year, not just on Netflix but among most of the anime released this year. The highly anticipated anime sequel was released last month after making fans wait for four years. Thanks to the hype of the series, the sequel also became a massive hit as the anime returns with ten episodes, just like the first season. Considering the first season’s popularity, it’s no surprise that the sequel was also a massive hit, even if it follows an entirely new set of characters instead of continuing the beloved story of David Martinez and Lucy.

Netflix Tudum reveals that the anime gathered more than 4.6 million views between October 19th and 25th, which was during the first week of the anime’s release. Since the week started on October 19th, the number of views mentioned here was from the first six days of the release. It also ranked third among the top 10 global non-English shows, which again proves how much the franchise is loved even after all these years. The anime sequel released all episodes at once , and since most of the fans have already watched it, the second season didn’t rank in the top 10 chart in the following week.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Follows a New Story

After a successful first season, the anime continues to explore the animated world of Night City. The sequel also helped the series flesh out the world-building that first started with CD Projekt Red’s video game, Cyberpunk 2077 . While the first season had a fairly conclusive ending, fans followed the story head towards a new direction with new characters. Instead of centering around an aspiring Edgerunner like David, the second season focuses on a character named Weak Kingsley. Weak is a past-his-prime veteran Edgerunner, who has long since become a legend of Night City. However, he is now mostly living without the technology that brought him to the top of the food chain. After a series of unexpected events, he finds himself dragged back into the world he once left behind.

Will There Be a Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 3?

So far, a sequel season hasn’t been officially confirmed yet , but fans can still expect an update in the next few years. The first season was released in 2022, and it took the anime three years to officially confirm a sequel. While the second season was announced in July 2025, it made its debut in October this year. Just like the first season, it wraps up the story of the protagonist. During the finale, Weak removed and downgraded all of his implants after nearly succumbing to cyberpsychosis, effectively ending his days as a legendary edgerunner. As the story ends, he drives away from Night City, along with Talia, as they both leave behind the corporate dystopia to help her find peace. This means that if the anime were to return with a third season, it would feature another story again centering around new characters, their struggles, and their journey.

title: 25 Years Later, Cowboy Bebop Director Breaks Silence on the Biggest Challenge With the Anime
content:
It’s been 25 years since the anime was released, but Shinichirō Watanabe’s Cowboy Bebop is still among one of the most popular shows of all time. The anime is commemorating a major milestone this year, which again brings the director into the spotlight as he shares updates on the upcoming 4K remastered version. Cowboy Bebop may be his most popular work, but Watanabe is known for directing several acclaimed shows over the decades , including Samurai Champloo, Kids on the Slope, Space Dandy , and many more. His latest project is Lazarus , which was released in 2024, but failed to get the response it deserved.

While the legendary director hasn’t shared any updates on his upcoming project, Cowboy Bebop is getting a major revival this year. Following the release of Lazarus , many wondered if the director would return with a sequel to the anime, but that’s not the case anymore. His next project will be something entirely new, although it’s uncertain when it will be announced. So far, the director hasn’t confirmed working on a new project, but fans are eagerly awaiting his return with another exciting story. During a recent interview, he talked about the anime’s latest project, which has been released only in Japan.

Cowboy Bebop Director Opens Up About the Biggest Challenge He Faced With the Anime

Animate Times shared the interview from the advanced screening of the latest 4K remastered movie, where Shinichiro Watanabe and composer Yoko Kanno were in attendance. He discussed the difficulties of preparing the 4K movie version of the series. Watanabe shared, “When you make an analog-era film high-definition, there are risks. (Because many cels are layered) in some works, the amount of cel dust becomes very noticeable. This work in particular has a lot of layered cels, so there was a risk that scratches and shadows would be visible, but Bandai Namco Filmworks and the post-production team did an incredible job, spending months manually erasing each frame and finishing it to a magnificent quality. I just said, ‘Erase it all, thanks to you,’ and left (laughs).”

This is the biggest risk he faced with the anime in 25 years, especially since the movie not only had to retain the beauty of the original but also provide fans with a much better quality than they are used to. The 90s animation style is loved for its grainy visuals and a color palette unique to that era, which hasn’t been replicated in recent years. This is all the more reason why Cowboy Bebop ‘s anniversary project couldn’t lose the charm of the original. The movie had to make a concise version of the TV show, but the biggest problem was avoiding the risk of getting shadows and scratches while working on the remaster. Bandai Namco Filmworks avoided the use of AI and did everything manually over the course of several months, which is why Watanabe is more than satisfied with the final result.

When Is Cowboy Bebop ‘s 4K Remastered Movie Coming to the U.S.?

The new movie, Cowboy Bebop: Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door , was released as an anniversary project in Japan. The movie is currently showing in Japanese theatres with no information on a U.S. release. The movie’s trailer features gorgeous visuals that international fans aren’t used to. However, so far, there have been no updates from Bandai Namco Filmworks on whether the movie will have a theatrical release in the U.S. first or if it will only get a Blu-ray DVD release. Cowboy Bebop maintains a huge fan base across the world , especially in the West, which is why there’s reason to believe the movie will eventually land in U.S. theatres, although there’s no telling how long fans will have to wait.

title: Beloved Fantasy’s Final Release Is the Biggest Hit of the Season Even Before Anime’s Return
content:
Yona of the Dawn continues to grab fans’ attention even after its finale, thanks to the anime sequel confirmation and the manga’s final release. Based on an acclaimed manga series written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, the anime premiered in 2014. After 16 years of serialization, the manga reached its conclusion in December last year before returning with four-chapter-long side stories. The last few chapters and the side stories were included in the final volume , which was released in Japan on October 20th, 2026. The manga’s final volume became a massive hit in Japan with estimated sales of 75,355 copies within the first week.

According to Oricon , Yona of the Dawn was the best-selling manga in the country for an entire week starting from October 19th to October 25th. The numbers only keep rising as the series has become incredibly popular over the years, which is the biggest reason why the anime even got a green light for a second season after more than a decade. Now that the manga has already released its final installment and the creator has no plans for returning with another side story or a spin-off, all fans can do is wait for the anime’s return. While details on the anime haven’t been revealed yet, here’s everything we know so far.

Yona of the Dawn Anime Sequel Confirmed Studio After Final Volume’s Release

Last month, the anime confirmed that Pierrot Films will be responsible for the sequel . It’s a subsidiary of Studio Pierrot, which handled the first season of the anime. The information was revealed in the final volume of the manga, which was sold in Japan. Additionally, the official X handle of the anime also shared this update to international fans. However, this is basically the only update we got from the anime series in almost a year. The anime sequel was confirmed in December last year, along with the manga’s final chapter. So far, it’s not even confirmed if it will be a TV series or a feature-length film, considering that the next installment is officially called a sequel rather than a Season 2.

What to Expect From Yona of the Dawn Anime’s Sequel

The first season of the anime barely covered the initial phase of the story when Yona gathered all Four Dragon Warriors from an ancient legend. However, her struggles have only just begun since she is still unable to decide what to do next in life. Chased out of her home and with nowhere left to go, Yona has lost everything in life, but now she must make a decision since her life is directly tied to Hak and the others. Her real journey will continue from here on out, where she encounters new allies and enemies as she walks down a difficult path to make the kingdom a more peaceful place. Along with her friends, she will travel all across the Kouka kingdom and beyond to fight for the good of the people. As mentioned in the prophecy, her journey will be far from easy, but that will also change everything around her.

title: Hana-Kimi Manga Gets New Live-Action Series, 1st Stage Play
content:
Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) will receive both a new live-action television series and its first stage production to commemorate its 30th anniversary.

The television series stars:

• Hana Kawamura as Mizuki Ashiya

• The Rampage member Makoto Hasegawa as Izumi Sano

• The Rampage member Itsuki Fujiwara as Shūichi Nakatsu

• Ryūgūjō member Keigo Itō as Shinji Noe

• Ryūgūjō member Yūki Tomita as Kyōgo Sekime

• Lienel member Miro Takaoka as Taiki Kayashima

• Lienel member Riku Morita as Senri Nakao

• Genosuke as Megumi Tennōji

• Tagright member Daigo Kobayashi as Minami Nanba

• Tagright member Tomoki Nishiyama as Masao Himejima

• Gekidan Exile member Yūki Sakurai as Itsuki Kujō

• Hiroto Takahashi as Makoto Kagurazaka

Keisuke Shibata and NTV 's Shiori Ueno are directing the series, and Fumie Koga , Yuka Arai , and Kazumi Ōki are writing the scripts with composition by Yōko Tamura. Kōji Endō ( Nyaight of the Living Cat , live-action Blade of the Immortal , Terra Formars ) is scoring the music. Shintarō Sugano is writing and directing the stage play.

The half-hour eight-episode series will premiere on the NTV channel on December 5 at 2:30 p.m. (12:30 a.m. EST). The TVer and Hulu services will stream the series in Japan, and Hulu will also stream a "director's cut" of the series.

The stage play will open with most of the series' cast one week after the series ends on February 13 in Osaka, before traveling to Aichi and Tokyo.

Viz Media describes the Hana-Kimi story:

Japanese-American track-and-field star Mizuki has gotten herself to transfer to a high school in Japan...but not just any school! To be close to her idol, high jumper Izumi Sano, she's going to an all-guys' high school...and disguising herself as a boy! But as fate would have it, they're more than classmates...they're roommates! Now, Mizuki must keep her secret in the classroom, the locker room, and her own bedroom. And her classmates--and the school nurse--must cope with a new transfer student who may make them question their own orientation...

Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ( Hana-Kimi ) was Nakajo's defining work, running in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine from 1996 to 2004.

Nakajo ran a short continuation of the Hana-Kimi manga in 2011, and published a special chapter in 2014. Her latest update to the series was Himitsu - Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e After School , which debuted in 2021. Viz Media published the Hana-Kimi manga in North America, and also published her Sugar Princess manga.

The manga inspired a 2007 live-action television series and a second live-action series starring AKB48 idol group member Atsuko Maeda in 2011. Besides the two Japanese live-action television series, the manga also inspired a live-action television version in South Korea and a 2006 live-action television version in Taiwan.

The anime adaptation had its episode 1 world premiere at the Anime NYC event on August 23, 2025. It premiered on the Tokyo MX channel on January 4, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. (7:30 a.m. EST), and it also ran on BS11 , MBS , CBC TV , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , and other channels. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with English subtitles and same-day dub in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, and India.

title: 2 Years Later, One Piece Finally Solves One of Its Biggest Mysteries About the Sun God and Luffy
content:
The One Piece manga is currently deep into the action-packed climax of the Elbaph arc, delivering the necessary power upgrades to its main characters. However, amidst all the action, the series has not forgotten to resolve some of its underlying mysteries. It has always been a pattern for One Piece to introduce several mysteries early on and gradually solve them during major climactic events. The fight in the Elbaph arc has revolved around the Straw Hats mastering Supreme King Haki to take down their opponents, which is particularly important since the new villains can only be defeated through this power. While Zoro has always possessed this ability, with the latest arc further solidifying his mastery, Sanji was still left behind.

However, the past few chapters have seemingly resolved Sanji’s complications , with the latest chapter further solidifying that he has almost mastered this power. This also comes alongside a strong declaration from Sanji, stating that Zoro can be Luffy’s sword while he will be his shield. This gives the two characters more defined roles, particularly Sanji, as Zoro has always been associated with his swordsmanship, while Sanji now takes on the role of the protector. What makes this even more intriguing, however, is that this declaration aligns with the depiction of the Sun God revealed earlier in the arc, who wields a shield and a sword as his weapons of choice. It now seems that Eiichiro Oda deliberately established this parallel.

One Piece Chapter 1197 Finally Solves a Major Sun God Mystery

Elbaph revealed a striking detail about the Sun God when the subject was first discussed in Chapter 1136, where Elder Jarul explained that there are different interpretations of Sun God Nika . While some revere him, others fear him as the God of Destruction. The intriguing detail was that this chapter featured one of the clearest depictions of the Sun God, which bore a striking resemblance to Luffy’s Gear 5, notably wielding a shield and a sword. In the Harley mural revealed a couple of chapters later, the Sun God’s depiction for the Third World once again featured a spear and a shield. Considering that this Third World revolves around Luffy, as the Sun God leading the rebellion against Imu and the World Government, the sword and shield could represent Zoro and Sanji.

Luffy is a fighter who does not rely on weapons, instead using his Devil Fruit and Haki as his primary tools. This means the deliberate choice to depict the Sun God with a sword and shield could represent the two important assets of the current Sun God: Zoro and Sanji. On closer inspection, the small detail of the sword being in the Sun God’s right hand while the shield is in his left also represents their importance and what they mean to Luffy. Both are equally important to him, and without either of them, Luffy would struggle to fulfill his dream of becoming the Pirate King.

One Piece author Eiichiro Oda has a habit of foreshadowing important elements from the very beginning, and it is once again amazing to see how Zoro and Sanji’s endgame roles for Luffy may have been hidden in plain sight. While this is a major development for Sanji and further highlights what both characters mean to Luffy and the Sun God, there are surely many more upgrades to come for them. The Final Saga will likely bring even more significant power-ups for Zoro and Sanji as their roles alongside Luffy become increasingly intertwined with the prophecy of Sun God Nika.

title: Shonen Jump’s Most Underrated Magical Action-Comedy Series Is Set to Take Over 2027
content:
Shonen Jump ‘s most underrated magical action-comedy series, which debuted in 2020, is getting a special revival in 2027. Over the past few years, Shonen Jump magazine has undergone significant changes. The most notable has been the shift toward shorter manga runs, with the magazine now more willing than ever to cancel series. One series that perfectly represents this shorter model while offering a unique narrative is actually Mashle: Magic and Muscles by Hajime Komoto, which first debuted in January 2020. The manga emerged as an intriguing new leading shonen series.

Like most popular manga series, it received an anime adaptation three years later, bringing its fun premise to life through A-1 Pictures, along with a banger of an opening theme for the first season that remains a fan favorite. However, the manga came to an end in 2023, shortly after the first season concluded. Although the anime’s second season arrived the following year, in 2024, the series has remained silent for almost three years. Recently, however, several details have emerged about the franchise, highlighting how it is secretly preparing to dominate Winter and Spring 2027 with two projects that could also give the manga a boost.

Shonen Jump’s Most Underrated 2020 Action-Comedy Is Set to Dominate 2027 With Two Major Projects

The Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime is set to return with a new season, picking up the story where the second season left off in March 2024. The new season will continue adapting the Divine Visionary Exam arc, which had already begun to gain fans’ attention. This exciting arc will continue as fans get to see how Mash’s muscles overcome the challenges presented by the upcoming events. It will bring the series closer to the manga’s original conclusion, and by the time the season ends, a fourth and final season of the anime could also be announced. However, the biggest project set to boost the franchise next year is its surprising live-action adaptation.

A few days ago, it was announced that the Mashle live-action movie is in production and nearing completion , with the announcement also revealing its release date. The film will arrive in Japanese theaters on March 19, 2027. Warner Bros. and Fuji TV are distributing the project, while CREDEUS is handling production. The studio has been working on live-action movie adaptations for some time, including the recent Sakamoto Days project, making it a fitting choice. However, the most exciting part is that Mackenyu, Netflix’s One Piece Zoro star, has been revealed as the actor playing the lead role of Mash Burnedead.

New information highlights that the role was offered to Mackenyu three years ago and that he has been building muscle for this particular character , rather than for Zoro. However, it was a blessing in disguise that Mackenyu ended up looking even more like Zoro in the second season. With these recent developments, Mashle is undoubtedly set to bloom with two major projects in the first half of 2027. Both projects are bound to give the manga series a boost as well, bringing much more attention to Shonen Jump’s underrated magical comedy, which blends the vibes of One-Punch Man and Harry Potter and deserves far more recognition.

title: 3 Zoro Moments That Prove He’s One Piece’s Perfect First Mate
content:
Any pirate across the course of history would be hard-pressed to find a better first mate than Roronoa Zoro in One Piece . The former bounty-hunting swordsman turned Straw-Hat Pirate, gives his all to his captain in every conflict and that’s what makes him the most loyal first mate in piracy. The second Zoro decided to join Monkey D. Luffy’s crew, he even gave up his greatest goal in favor of serving his captain’s every wish.

Luffy helped Zoro escape Marine captivity, and in return, Zoro said he’d become a criminal. He then added that his goal was to become “the world’s greatest swordsman ,” and he’d hold Luffy personally responsible for making him give up his dream if that happens along the way. Instead, the captain encouraged his dream all the more, saying that he’d expect nothing less as someone in service to the future King of the Pirates. Throughout the years, Luffy has held true to giving Zoro every shot at achieving his goal, and his first mate has repaid him with unmatched allegiance and selfless servitude.

3) Tries To Cut Off His Legs To Save Crew

An absolutely absurd situation occurs before One Piece even reaches the triple digits in episode count. Zoro, Nami and Vivi are slowly succumbing to No. 3’s horrifying wax-to-death attack, but the first mate refuses to go down without a fight, even if he can’t stand on his own two legs. Ever the crazy swordsman, he actually tries to sever his legs. Thankfully, Luffy returns in time to get them out of the mess, or Zoro might’ve accomplished it. He even jokes with Nami that he got halfway through.

An insane attempt on multiple levels. First, he’d just been dominated by the current world’s greatest swordsman in Dracule Mihawk a couple sagas ago. This move would’ve forever hampered his abilities to reach that goal and topple Mihawk, but Zoro’s dogged determination wouldn’t let his friends die for nothing. Second, even if he had gotten out of the trap, what would he have done with no legs? In an alternate universe, could he really take out the Baroque Works agents with no legs? Zoro likely believed he could or die trying. Either way, it made for an awesome scene, and one of his most selfless moments.

2) Impassioned Speech Backing Luffy’s Captainship

Zoro takes his duty as first mate seriously and there was no better example of that than when he stood up for Luffy when his role as captain came into question. Usopp challenges Luffy to a fight for ownership of the Going Merry. Unsurprisingly, Luffy wins the fight, and Usopp leaves the crew. No one threatens to leave after Usopp’s departure, but his first mate issues a two-fold speech backing the captain and essentially demanding more from him.

He states that Luffy is the captain regardless of his Laissez-Faire attitude and stupidity. Still, Zoro demands that he hold the crew to a standard and that means not letting Usopp back into the Straw Hats without an apology. It’s a time where the Straw Hats were splintering and instead of trying to take over the crew or endorse someone else, he proves once again that he’s the voice of reason. He gives a major vote of confidence to his captain.

1) Zoro Risks Life & Takes All Of Luffy’s Damage

This choice should come as no surprise, but this scene doesn’t get the credit it deserves. Luffy is on death’s door, and is about to be taken by Bartholomew Kuma, until Zoro comes to his rescue. With the captain incapacitated, Zoro strikes a deal with Kuma to trade his life for Luffy’s. Kuma agrees, as he can draw Luffy’s pain and fatigue out of his body and pass it to Zoro through what appears to be a bubble. However, Kuma advises the swordsman that the experience is likely to kill him.

He sends a small amount of the pain to Zoro, who convulses back and forth in extreme agony. Undeterred by the hellish experience, Zoro steps forward and presses both hands into the bubble which turns into a freeze frame scene. No one knows exactly what has become of Zoro when they wake up. Sanji is the first to find Zoro covered in blood, and asks Zoro what happened. To which Zoro simply answered that nothing happened.

This sacrifice is above and beyond the call of duty for any first mate. At this point, most people would’ve let Luffy get taken, especially after the initial taste of what the pain could do. This is the ultimate scene in what makes Zoro the perfect first mate. He’d literally risk his own life to save his captain and his captain’s dream. It’s one of the most selfless and humble act of the whole series and that’s saying a lot for a series that’s closing in on 1,200 episodes, and yet, it’s pure Zoro. What do you think? Are these the three most humble moments of Roronoa Zoro? Let us know in the comments.

title: Odd Taxi Manga Author Launches New Rematch With You Manga in Late November
content:
Manga creator Takeichi Abaraya announced on Wednesday that they will launch a new manga titled Rematch With You in Akita Shoten 's YanChan Web manga website later this month. Abaraya previously published a dōjin version of the manga titled "My last Match With You" at the Comitia event in November 2025. The manga also has its own official X/Twitter account .

Abaraya launched the manga adaptation of the Odd Taxi original anime in the Darupana website spinoff of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in January 2021, and ended it in June 2022. Shogakukan published five compiled book volumes for the manga. Denpa and KUMA licensed the manga, and will begin releasing the manga with the first volume in May 2027.

Abaraya launched the RoOT/Route of Odd Taxi (stylized with a backwards R in "RoOT") manga spinoff for Odd Taxi in Darupana in February 2023, and ended it in April 2025. Shogakukan published six volumes for the manga. The manga inspired a live-action television series that aired in April 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the series.
